uncertainties: The checked-in generated catalog is a snapshot at its recorded generated_at; this audit did not execute catalog generation or compare against a live Supabase tool registry. DB-active binding and per-surface inclusion therefore remain unverified here.

The legacy and canonical wait_for handlers share one name. Agent dispatch resolves the canonical last-write winner, while the Tools UI exposes raw handler rows and runs the selected handler object directly. Existing inventory says the legacy row is inapplicable; source proves this depends on whether a procedure means agent dispatch or Tools manual execution.
Guest=false is consistent with the inventory reason that Tools UI requires sign-in; no native UI/auth execution was performed.
Historical feature IDs were preserved in the audit rows; no inventory, source catalog, or test result was edited.
